name: Lesson 12 · For me, without you: accusative prepositions and pronouns

cards.note: Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. für always takes the accusative: der Vater → meinen Vater.

cards.front: I'm buying a cake for **my brother**.
cards.back: Ich kaufe einen Kuchen für **meinen Bruder**.
cards.note: Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. für + accusative: meinen Bruder.
Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. die-words do not change: für meine Mutter.

cards.front: I need the car for **one day**.
cards.back: Ich brauche das Auto für **einen Tag**.
cards.note: Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. für with a length of time: für einen Tag.
Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. ohne takes the accusative: seinen Mantel.
Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. ohne + a noun with no article: ohne Zucker, ohne Milch.
Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. ohne: without. Like English, no article here.
Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. durch takes the accusative: der Park → den Park.
Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. durch die Stadt: die stays die.
Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. laufen changes au to äu: er läuft. durch den Wald: accusative.
Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. der Wald → den Wald after durch.
Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. durch: along and through, from one end to the other.
Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. gegen: against, also hitting something. der Baum → einen Baum.

cards.front: The children are playing against **the parents**.
cards.note: Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. gegen + accusative; the plural die stays die.

cards.front: On Saturday we play against **your team**. (several friends)
cards.back: Am Samstag spielen wir gegen **euer Team**.
cards.note: Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. gegen + accusative: das Team → euer Team, no ending.
Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. gegen before a time means roughly: around eight. um acht would be exactly at eight.
Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. um as a place means around: um die Ecke, with the accusative.

cards.front: The children are running around **the table**.
cards.note: Prepositions with the accusative: für, ohne, durch, gegen, um. um + accusative: der Tisch → den Tisch.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. ich as the object becomes mich.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. mich: me, the object.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. du as the object becomes dich.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. für takes the accusative, so für dich.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. ohne + accusative: dich.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. er as the object becomes ihn. nicht comes after the pronoun.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. ihn: him.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. ohne + accusative: ihn.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. A der-word is ihn as an object, even a thing.

cards.front: How do you like the film? (one friend) – I like **it**.
cards.back: Wie findest du den Film? – Ich finde **ihn** gut.
cards.note: Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. der Film → ihn: the pronoun follows the noun's gender, not English it.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. sie stays sie as the object.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. A die-word is sie as an object too.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. A das-word is es, as subject or object.

cards.front: She loves him, and he loves **her**.
cards.back: Sie liebt ihn, und er liebt **sie**.
cards.note: Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. sie does not change in the accusative; er does: ihn.

cards.front: Are you visiting **us** on Sunday? (one friend)
cards.note: Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. wir as the object becomes uns.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. gegen + accusative: uns.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. ihr as the object becomes euch.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. für + accusative: euch.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. Formal Sie does not change in the accusative.
Accusative pronouns: mich, dich, ihn…. sie (they) as the object is still sie.
